venira.output_kind: from, to, kind, overwritten, entries, bytes. Missing source gives not_found, an existing target without overwrite gives conflict.
venira.speed_profile: fast; clears the read/list/search cache for both paths.
venira.use_when: you rename or relocate files or folders. Not undoable: take a snapshot first when they are not in git.

description:
Move or rename a file or directory inside the workspace. overwrite=true replaces an existing file, never a directory; create_dirs (default true) makes missing parents of `to`.
Use when: you rename or relocate files or folders. Not undoable: take a snapshot first when they are not in git.
Avoid when: you duplicate (copy_path) or remove (delete_path).
Output: from, to, kind, overwritten, entries, bytes. Missing source gives not_found, an existing target without overwrite gives conflict.

create_dirs.description: true creates missing parent directories of `to` (default true).

from.description: Existing workspace path to move or rename.

overwrite.description: true replaces an existing target file (default false). A directory is never replaced.

to.description: New workspace path: the final name, not a parent directory.

name: move_path
title: Move path
